title: Excruciate
summary: EXCRU'CIATE, verb transitive [Latin excrucio; ex and crucio, to torment, from crux, a cross.] To torture; to torment; to inflict most severe pain on; as, to excruciate the heart or the body.

inlines.v: EXCRU'CIATE, verb transitive [Latin excrucio; ex and crucio, to torment, from crux, a cross.] To torture; to torment; to inflict most severe pain on; as, to excruciate the heart or the body.
